description: Recorded licences of the fonts Alpha ships (packages/design-system/fonts), each by the exact file hashes it covers; `pnpm licences` reads it (spec/app/release/licences.md). An open font names its SPDX licence and source. A proprietary font is recorded in one of two states. Full: {name, sha256: [..], license: "LicenseRef-Commercial-Font", licensor, licensee, scope (naming app and web embedding), evidence (where the signed licence is held), recordedOn}. Owner statement: {name, sha256: [..], license: "LicenseRef-Commercial-Font", evidence: "held-outside-repository", holder, basis, recordedOn, optional reference}, which records only what the owner stated and stays flagged. A shipped font with no record is flagged as having no licence recorded.

entries.name: Denton typeface
entries.basis: owner states the licence is held; the licence document is kept outside this repository
